mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_UnauthNoAudit removes the rule that unauthenticated operations cannot have audit entries or permitted outcomes; the injection forces an unauthenticated operation with an audit, which is the precise violation FR_001_AuthRequired exists to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthHasAudit { some op: Operation | op.authenticated = False and some op.audit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_CareTeamRequired removes the care-team predicate gating ReadRecord/AddNote; the injection witnesses a permitted clinical access for a clinician with no active care-team membership for that patient, which OwnershipBasedAccess and FR_004 must reject.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoCareTeamButPermitted { some op: Operation | op.opOutcome = Permitted and op.opKind = ReadRecord and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.clinician = op.caller and m.carePatient = op.opPatient and m.status = Active) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AdminNoClinicalContent removes the rule that hospital administrators cannot get a Permitted outcome on clinical endpoints; the injection forces an admin successfully reading a record, violating both FR-005 and least privilege.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminReadsClinical { some op: Operation | op.caller.role = HospitalAdministrator and op.opKind = ReadRecord and op.opOutcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditCompleteness removes the always-on audit rule for clinical endpoints; the injection witnesses an authenticated, validated ReadRecord operation with no audit entry, which FR-012 exists to forbid.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAudit { some op: Operation | op.authenticated = True and op.validated = True and op.opKind = ReadRecord and no op.audit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries removes the rule that every audit entry is uniquely owned by some operation; the injection introduces an orphan AuditEntry no operation maps to, exactly the kind of fabricated/edited row append-only is supposed to prevent.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OrphanAudit { some a: AuditEntry | all op: Operation | op.audit != a }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_NoteAuthorIsClinical removes the schema CHECK that excludes hospital_administrator from authorship; the injection witnesses a note whose snapshotted author_role is the administrator, violating the content-blindness invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminAuthorsNote { some n: ClinicalNote | n.authorRoleSnapshot = HospitalAdministrator }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_ValidationGate removes the rule that an invalid request creates no state and no audit; the injection witnesses a validated=False operation that nonetheless created a note, which the ValidationBeforeMutation pattern must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InvalidCreatesNote { some op: Operation | op.validated = False and some op.noteCreated }
